item.title: More complete connected-health summaries
item.summary: Murph can now use sleep latency, separate activity-intensity minutes, additional heart-rate fields, and bounded profile and cycle facts from connected health sources.
item.details: Activity intensity keeps the source's minute values. Newer profile and cycle corrections now replace changed facts and remove omitted facts, while invalid dates, predictions, unfamiliar values, and legacy length fields remain bounded supporting evidence.
